```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()

library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
```

# RAREFY DATA

# 1. Import Data

```{r}
# Import 16S Abundance table
atc_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE) 
dim(atc_16S) # 4615 720

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_16S_nocontrol <- atc_16S %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_16S_nocontrol) # 4615 336

# Deletion of 16S- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol) <- gsub("16S_", "", colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol))

# Import ITS Abundance table
atc_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(atc_ITS) # 1303 553

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_ITS_nocontrol <- atc_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_ITS_nocontrol) # 1303 300

# Deletion of ITS- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol) <- gsub("ITS_", "", colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol))


# Import 16S and ITS taxonomy tables
taxo_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM123_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)

taxo_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM123_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)


# Import Metadata table
metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "1_PrepareData", "TransMicro123_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)

samples_to_distinguish <- c("CT_INDEX_3_rn2", "MS_001_rn3", "MS_098_rn3", "MS_148_rn3", "MS_151_rn3", "MS_163_rn3", "MS_167_rn3", "MS_263_rn3")

metadata <- add_marker_to_id(metadata, samples_to_distinguish)

length(unique((metadata$ID_pool)[ metadata$Marker != "ITS"])) #nb of 16S samples = 464
length(unique((metadata$ID_pool)[ metadata$Marker != "16S"])) #nb of ITS samples = 374

write.table(metadata, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM123_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```

# 2. Create a phyloseq object

```{r}
# Abundance tables
otu_16S <- atc_16S_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL)

otu_ITS <- atc_ITS_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL) 

# Taxonomy tables
tax_16S <- taxo_16S %>% 
  #dplyr::left_join(atc_16S_nocontrol %>% select(observation_name, seed_sequence) , by = "observation_name") %>%
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_16S <- as.matrix(tax_16S)

tax_ITS <- taxo_ITS %>% 
  #dplyr::left_join(atc_ITS_nocontrol %>% select(observation_name, seed_sequence) , by = "observation_name") %>%
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_ITS <- as.matrix(tax_ITS)

# Metadata
mtd <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool = sapply(ID_pool, Remove_last_two_chars_run)) %>% # Remove runs distinction (1, 2 or 3)
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool_rowname = ID_pool) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ID_pool_rowname = ID_pool) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Marker, -Run) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(ID_pool) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across( .cols = everything(), .fns = ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), paste(unique(.x), collapse = ";")) ), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("ID_pool_rowname")
  

write.table(mtd, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM123_reduced_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

#Transform into phyloseq compatible objects
OTU_16S <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_16S, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_16S <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_16S))

OTU_ITS <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_ITS, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_ITS <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_ITS))

#MTD <- phyloseq::sample_data(as.data.frame(mtd))
# # Build a phyloseq objects
# ps_16S <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_16S, TAX_16S, MTD)
# ps_ITS <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_ITS, TAX_ITS, MTD)

ps_16S <- phyloseq(OTU_16S, TAX_16S, sample_data(mtd))
ps_ITS <- phyloseq(OTU_ITS, TAX_ITS, sample_data(mtd))

ps_16S_raw <- merge_samples(ps_16S,group = "ID_pool",fun = sum)
ps_ITS_raw <- merge_samples(ps_ITS,group = "ID_pool",fun = sum)

sample_data(ps_16S_raw) <- sample_data(ps_16S) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(ID_pool) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), NA)
  )) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID_pool") %>%
  sample_data()

sample_data(ps_ITS_raw) <- sample_data(ps_ITS) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(ID_pool) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ ifelse(length(unique(.x)) == 1, unique(.x), NA)
  )) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID_pool") %>%
  sample_data()


# Export
saveRDS(ps_16S_raw, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_raw.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITS_raw, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_raw.rds"))


# Plot tot. ASVs abundances per sample
df_16S <- data.frame(reads = taxa_sums(ps_16S))

df_ITS <- data.frame(reads = taxa_sums(ps_ITS))

ggplot(df_ITS, aes(x = reads)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "white", color="black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Tot. reads per ASV (log10)", y = "Count of ASVs")
```

# 3. Remove conta.

```{r}
ps_16S_raw <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_raw.rds"))
ps_ITS_raw <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_raw.rds"))
# Remove Wolbachia
tax_ps <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_16S_raw ))

wolbachia_taxa <- rownames(tax_ps[!is.na(tax_ps$Genus) & tax_ps$Genus == "Wolbachia", ]) # List of Wolbachia clusters

otu_ps <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_16S_raw))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_16S_raw )) otu_ps <- t(otu_ps)

sum(otu_ps[wolbachia_taxa, , drop = FALSE]) / sum(otu_ps) * 100 ## Relative abundance of Wolbachia = 16.76 %

ps_16Sm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_16S_raw ) %in% wolbachia_taxa), ps_16S_raw ) ## Remove


# Remove 16S conta
TAX_16S_df <- as.data.frame(TAX_16S)
Genus_conta_16S <- c("Lentihominibacter", "Cutibacterium", "Corynebacterium")
Fam_conta_16S <- c("Anaerovoracaceae")

taxa_to_remove_16S <- TAX_16S_df %>%
  filter(Family %in% Fam_conta_16S | Genus %in% Genus_conta_16S) %>%
  rownames()
  
write.xlsx( TAX_16S_df[taxa_to_remove_16S, ], file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data",  "2_RarefyData","Conta_clusters_16S.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE) #export removed clusers

ps_16Sm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_16Sm) %in% taxa_to_remove_16S),ps_16Sm)


# Remove ITS conta
Fam_conta_ITS <- c("Malasseziaceae")
TAX_ITS_df <- as.data.frame(TAX_ITS)

taxa_to_remove_ITS <- TAX_ITS_df %>%
  filter(Family %in% Fam_conta_ITS) %>%
  rownames()
  
write.xlsx( TAX_ITS_df[taxa_to_remove_ITS, ], file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data",  "2_RarefyData","Conta_clusters_ITS.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE) #export removed clusers

ps_ITSm <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps_ITS_raw) %in% taxa_to_remove_ITS),ps_ITS_raw)

# Infos
sum_physeq_clean(ps_16S_raw , ps_16Sm) # filtered : 0% of samples + 3.6% of ASVs + 20.0 % of reads
sum_physeq_clean(ps_ITS_raw , ps_ITSm) # filtered : 0% of samples + 2.92% of ASVs + 0.622 % of reads

# Export
saveRDS(ps_16Sm, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_contaRemoved.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITSm, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_contaRemoved.rds"))
```

# 4. Remove low-depth samples

```{r}
ps_16Sm <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_contaRemoved.rds"))
ps_ITSm <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_contaRemoved.rds"))

#threshold for min. reads per sample at 150 for 16S & 250 for ITS
ps_16Sm_sq <- ps_16Sm %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>% # remove samples with zeros reads
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) # remove taxa absent in all samples

ps_ITSm_sq <- ps_ITSm %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)

sum_physeq_clean(ps_16Sm, ps_16Sm_sq) # filtered : 16.4% of samples + 77.7% of ASVs + 0.008 % of reads
sum_physeq_clean(ps_ITSm, ps_ITSm_sq) # filtered : 3.36% of samples + 36.1% of ASVs + 0.005 % of reads

# Export
saveRDS(ps_16Sm_sq, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_contaRemoved_lowDepthFiltered.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITSm_sq, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_contaRemoved_lowDepthFiltered.rds"))
```

# 5. Distinguish datasets

```{r}
ps_16Sm_sq <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_ps_contaRemoved_lowDepthFiltered.rds"))
ps_ITSm_sq <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_ps_contaRemoved_lowDepthFiltered.rds"))

## Dataset 1 : fruits Batch 1 + individuals Batch 1


# Filter samples by abundance (>0) and type (fruits and suzu at all stages from "Focal_Sites")
ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1 <- subset_samples(ps_16Sm_sq, Sample_Category %in% c("All_stages_Focal_Sites", "All_stages_focal_Sites")) #exclude indiv. naturally infesting + naturally infested fruits, if want to include use -> grepl("Focal_Sites", Sample_Category))
ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1)>0, ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1)


ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1 <- subset_samples(ps_ITSm_sq, Sample_Category %in% c("All_stages_Focal_Sites", "All_stages_focal_Sites"))
ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1)>0, ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1)

# Export
saveRDS(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", "16S_ps_cleaned_Dataset_1.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_cleaned_Dataset_1.rds"))



## Dataset 2 : fruits Batch 1 + fruits Batch 2 (supp. mat.)

ps_16S_cl_Dataset_2 <- subset_samples(ps_16Sm_sq, SampleType %in% c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
ps_16S_cl_Dataset_2 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_2)>0,ps_16S_cl_Dataset_2) 


ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_2 <- subset_samples(ps_ITSm_sq, SampleType %in% c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_2 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_2)>0,ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_2)

## Export
saveRDS(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_2", "16S_ps_cleaned_Dataset_2.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_2", "ITS_ps_cleaned_Dataset_2.rds"))
```

# 6. Filter ASVs

```{r}
ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", "16S_ps_cleaned_Dataset_1.rds"))
ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_cleaned_Dataset_1.rds"))

ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1 <- filter_phyloseq_prevalence(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1, prevalence = 0.6)
ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1 <- filter_phyloseq_prevalence(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1, prevalence = 0.6)

#without filtering on prevalence
ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1 <- ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1
ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1 <- ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1

# Filter on ASVs prevalence per sample + samples with null abundance 
sum_physeq_clean(ps_16S_cl_Dataset_1, ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1) # filtered : 1.40% of samples + 90.4% of ASVs + 6.24 % of reads
sum_physeq_clean(ps_ITS_cl_Dataset_1, ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1) # filtered : 0% of samples + 75.5% of ASVs + 7.22 % of reads

# Add the row names in 'ID_pool' column
sample_data(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1)$ID_pool <- sample_names(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1)
sample_data(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1)$ID_pool <- sample_names(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1)

## Export
saveRDS(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "16S_ps_cleaned_NOTfiltered_Dataset_1.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_cleaned_NOTfiltered_Dataset_1.rds"))
```

# 7. Rarefaction curves
```{r}
## Rarefaction curves

# Dataset 1
ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "16S_ps_cleaned_NOTfiltered_Dataset_1.rds"))

ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_cleaned_NOTfiltered_Dataset_1.rds"))


# Plots
Rarefactioncurve_16S_D1 <- phyloseq.extended::ggrare(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "SampleType", label = "ID_pool") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3000, linetype = "dashed") + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", name = "Species Richness (log10)") + xlim(0, 10000)  +  theme_bw()

title_plot <- "16S_D1_NOTfiltered_Rarefactioncurve.png"

  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1" , title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_16S_D1, base_height = 35/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


Rarefactioncurve_ITS_D1 <- phyloseq.extended::ggrare(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "SampleType", label = "ID_pool") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5000, linetype = "dashed") + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", name = "Species Richness (log10)") +  xlim(0, 10000) +  theme_bw()

title_plot <- "ITS_D1_NOTfiltered_Rarefactioncurve.png"

  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_ITS_D1, base_height = 35/cm(1),base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

    
# Combined plot
RarefactionCurves_D1 <- ggpubr::ggarrange(Rarefactioncurve_16S_D1, Rarefactioncurve_ITS_D1,
                    labels = c("A. 16S", "B. ITS"), ncol = 2, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.4, 1.4), legend = "bottom", common.legend = TRUE)

title_plot <- "RarefactionCurves_NOTfiltered_D1.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", title_plot), RarefactionCurves_D1, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)  
```

# 8. Rarefy data

```{r}
#Dataset 1

# Rarefy samples by discarding samples with fewer than 3.000 reads
set.seed(1)                                         
ps_rare_16S_D1 <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1, sample.size = 3000) 

set.seed(1)                                         
ps_rare_ITS_D1 <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1, sample.size = 5000)

# Infos on loss
sum_physeq_clean(ps_16S_filt_Dataset_1, ps_rare_16S_D1) # filtered : 14.2% of samples (20) + 0% of ASVs + 80 % of reads
sum_physeq_clean(ps_ITS_filt_Dataset_1, ps_rare_ITS_D1) # filtered : 6.86% of samples (12) + 0% of ASVs + 63.3 % of reads

## Export
saveRDS(ps_rare_16S_D1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "16S_ps_rare_NF_D1.rds"))
```
